name: Halflife for ChatGPT
description: Check whether a ChatGPT answer is out of date, using your own local Halflife engine. Only answers you choose are sent.

content_security_policy.extension_pages: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self'; style-src 'self'; img-src 'self'; connect-src http://127.0.0.1:* http://localhost:*; object-src 'none'; base-uri 'none'; form-action 'none'; frame-ancestors 'none'
